a: TTP-E ~$600K/24 mo; TTP-T up to $1.2M/36 mo; TTP-P up to $2M/48 mo
dt: TTP-T and TTP-P: third Tuesday of Nov and May; TTP-E accepted anytime
e: Supports use-inspired and translational research that moves university results toward practice with partners (successor to PFI-style awards). TTP-E requires an active eligible NSF research award; lead must be a US university; no citizenship restriction.
n: NSF TIP: Translation to Practice (TTP, NSF 25-540)
unv: That TTP replaced PFI is inferred; PFI has no current solicitation.
